it tied to my
memories?

about it.

again!

Sky Fort. Thank

little friend?
Good! He was
just playing?
I didn't expect
that...

friend found?
Good! More
allies
make you
stronger.
Take care of
them.

your missing
friend is?
There
aren't many
places
to hide someone
in this zone.

for
your friend? At
least you've
found
a way toward
the
ruins where
he's
trapped.

your
friend? Well
done!
I'm impressed.

Earth Fort?

it's
underground.
I know the
water,
not the earth.
